title: The generic integrations: VTK, OpenUSD and OpenMDAO over the scientific layer
note: SX1-SX10 remove, one at a time, what keeps a representation or an exploration honest: the VTK cell order and its round-trip tolerance, the field's consistency checks, the USD scene's unit and domain checks, the DOE's admission of only declared, numeric, in-bounds parameters, its byte-for-byte cross-check of every case against a direct run, and its refusal of a response the model failed to compute.

mutations.name: SX1_cells_written_in_the_wrong_order
mutations.rationale: a three-axis field is written z-fastest, so every reader places the values in the wrong cells

mutations.name: SX2_the_round_trip_tolerates_anything
mutations.replace: if False and not np.all(err <= lim):
mutations.rationale: a lossy document passes its own read-back

mutations.name: SX3_a_cell_array_of_the_wrong_shape_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an array that does not fit the grid is exported as though it did

mutations.name: SX4_a_cell_array_without_a_unit_is_accepted
mutations.replace: if False and name not in self.units:
mutations.rationale: a field whose unit is not declared is exported, and a reader has to guess it

mutations.name: SX5_a_non_positive_unit_scale_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a stage with a zero or negative metersPerUnit is written

mutations.name: SX6_a_probe_outside_the_domain_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a probe placed outside the modelled domain is drawn as if it were a reading of it

mutations.name: SX8_a_range_outside_the_declared_bounds_is_explored
mutations.find:

mutations.name: SX9_the_cross_check_compares_to_a_tolerance
mutations.rationale: a case that came back through OpenMDAO one ulp away from the model's own output is called identical

mutations.name: SX10_a_failed_response_is_explored
mutations.find:

mutations.rationale: a response the model failed to compute is skipped, and the exploration reports a design space it never evaluated
